g.text: Replaces AMS1117-3.3 LDO: ~90% efficiency instead of burning 1.7V x Iload (0.85W at 500mA).

g.desc: Replaces AMS1117-3.3 LDO: ~90% efficiency instead of burning 1.7V x Iload (0.85W at 500mA).

g.text: USB-C -> IP5306 SOP-8 (charge + boost) -> SY8089AAAC buck -> 3.3V rail

g.desc: USB-C -> IP5306 SOP-8 (charge + boost) -> SY8089AAAC buck -> 3.3V rail

g.text: - GND via exposed pad only (must solder to ground plane)

g.desc: - GND via exposed pad only (must solder to ground plane)

g.text: !! v1 as-built: NOT in series - cannot disconnect battery

g.desc: !! v1 as-built: NOT in series - cannot disconnect battery

g.text: - IP5306 eSOP-8: integrated charger + synchronous boost (no ext. Schottky)

g.desc: - IP5306 eSOP-8: integrated charger + synchronous boost (no ext. Schottky)

g.text: - 1uH inductor: BAT -> L1 -> SW (>4.5A saturation, shielded)

g.desc: - 1uH inductor: BAT -> L1 -> SW (>4.5A saturation, shielded)

g.text: - SY8089AAAC buck: 3.327V for ESP32-S3 and peripherals (2A cont., 3A peak)

g.text: - C2 (22uF tantalum) DELETED: reversed assembly destroyed prototype #1; C30 is a non-polarized MLCC

g.text: Power on/off = IP5306 KEY + auto-standby. v2: wire pins 1-2 in series.

g.desc: Power on/off = IP5306 KEY + auto-standby. v2: wire pins 1-2 in series.

g.text: - KEY pulled to +5V via 100k for always-on operation
